# defineResource reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/define-resource-reference.mjs from packages/adula/src/resource/types.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm docs:reference`. -->

Every option of `defineResource({ … })` and every field type, generated from the TSDoc comments of
[`packages/adula/src/resource/types.ts`](../../packages/adula/src/resource/types.ts). The
[resource definitions guide](../resources.md) explains how to use them: columns, wire values,
list filters, migrations and validation.

A Default of `required` means the option must be given; `—` means it is optional and has no default.

## Resource options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Table and resource name: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and `_`; at most 63 characters. |
| `label` | `Label` | required | The list heading, usually plural (for example «الحسابات»). |
| `recordLabel` | `Label` | — | The singular record noun (for example «حساب»). Generated pages say «إضافة حساب» instead of the generic «إضافة سجل». |
| `createLabel` | `Label` | — | Full create-button text when «إضافة <recordLabel>» does not fit (for example «مهمة جديدة»). |
| `model` | `LucidModel` | — | Optional: AdulaJS persists through Knex and never reads it. Applications that use Lucid models in their own code may keep declaring it. |
| `scoped` | `boolean` | required | `true` adds `org_unit_id`: records belong to an organization unit and follow its scope. |
| `scope` | `{ from: string }` | — | The organization unit of a scoped record follows a required belongsTo parent, for example a clinic follows its facility. The unit is copied from the parent before authorization, the actor must be able to view the parent, and the form has no unit picker. `ResourceService.rehome` moves the children after the parent moves. |
| `submittable` | `boolean` | `false` | Records are documents: draft, submit, cancel and amend-by-copy, with workflows. |
| `version` | `boolean` | the value of `submittable` | Optimistic versions: updates send the current version and stale writes are 409. |
| `fields` | `Record<string, Field>` | required | The fields by key (camelCase; the column is the snake_case key unless `column` is set). |
| `list` | `readonly string[]` | required | Field keys shown as list columns, in order. |
| `form` | `readonly string[]` | required | Field keys of the create and edit form, in order. |
| `show` | `readonly string[]` | required | Field keys of the record details view, in order. |
| `serialize` | `readonly string[]` | the keys of `list` and `show` | Field keys returned by reads and the API. |
| `hidden` | `readonly string[]` | — | Field keys that need permission level 1 or more to see or write. |
| `title` | `readonly string[]` | the first sequence field and the first text field in `list` | Fields that name a record wherever it is referenced: relation cells and pickers, "My tasks" and the approvals inbox. Joined with « · ». |
| `actions` | `readonly Action[]` | required | Operations the resource offers: view, create, update, delete, and submit, cancel and amend on a submittable resource. Role rules still decide who may use each one. |
| `unique` | `readonly (readonly string[])[]` | — | Field combinations that must be unique among live records (a partial unique index `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`, and `AND doc_status <> 2` on a submittable resource so cancelled documents do not count), for example `[['customerId', 'code']]`. Every key is a stored field, or `orgUnitId` on a scoped resource (a code unique per unit). |
| `validator` | `{ validate(data: unknown): Promise<RecordData> }` | — | Optional: without it, writes are validated by the VineJS validator derived from the fields (see definitionValidator). A given validator replaces the derived one; field constraints are enforced again when values are stored, whatever the validator returns. |
| `hooks` | `{ beforeSave?: (record: RecordData, context: HookContext) => Promise<void>; afterSave?: (record: RecordData, context: HookContext) => Promise<void> }` | — | Functions called inside the write transaction, before and after a record is stored. |

## Common field props

Every field accepts these props, whatever its `type`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `Label` | required | Field label in forms, list headers and messages. |
| `column` | `string` | the field key in snake_case | Column name when it is not the snake_case form of the field key. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | A value is needed (at least one for multiSelect and manyToMany). The column is `NOT NULL` unless the field has `visibleWhen`. |
| `unique` | `boolean` | `false` | A partial unique index over live rows (`WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`); on a submittable resource cancelled documents do not count. Not on multiSelect, manyToMany or hasMany. |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | `false` | Allowed in the list `sort` parameter. Not on multiSelect, manyToMany or hasMany. |
| `searchable` | `boolean` | `false` | Part of the generated full-text search vector. Only string, text, email, url, phone, enum and lookup. |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | `false` | Offered as a list filter (`filters[key]=value`). |
| `permissionLevel` | `number` | `0` | The actor permission level needed to see or write the field. A field listed in the resource's `hidden` needs at least 1. |
| `sequence` | `string` | — | Numbering sequence key; the next number is assigned on create and the field is not part of the form input. |
| `default` | `Scalar \| string[]` | — | Applied on create when the input omits the key (server side, before validation), prefilled in the create form, and the column default for scalar types. An array only for multiSelect. Not allowed on relations, attachments, json or sequences. |
| `visibleWhen` | `Record<string, Scalar \| Scalar[]>` | — | The field applies only while every named sibling field equals the value (or one of the listed values; a multiSelect sibling must contain it). While it does not apply the form hides the field, `required` is not enforced and the server stores null (an empty list for manyToMany), on create and on update alike, except that an update keeps the stored value of a field the actor may not write. Values are canonical values of the sibling (checked by defineResource), for example '12.50' for a decimal sibling with scale 2. |

## Field types

`string` · `text` · `email` · `url` · `phone` · `integer` · `money` · `decimal` · `percent` · `boolean` · `date` · `datetime` · `json` · `enum` · `multiSelect` · `manyToMany` · `attachment` · `belongsTo` · `user` · `hasMany` · `lookup`

### `string`

A single-line trimmed string, varchar(255).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` | — | Minimum length in characters. |
| `max` | `number` | — | Maximum length in characters. The column caps it: 255 for string, 254 for email, 32 for phone and 2048 for url. |
| `pattern` | `string` | — | RegExp source the whole value must match (trimmed except for text): `'\\d{10}'` means ten digits. |
| `format` | `'email' \| 'url' \| 'phone'` | — | Also check the value as an e-mail address, URL or phone number. |

### `text`, `email`, `url`, `phone`

`text`: unlimited text, not trimmed. `email`: a trimmed, lower-case address. `url`: an absolute http(s) URL. `phone`: `+?digits`, 7 to 15 digits.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` | — | Minimum length in characters. |
| `max` | `number` | — | Maximum length in characters. The column caps it: 255 for string, 254 for email, 32 for phone and 2048 for url. |
| `pattern` | `string` | — | RegExp source the whole value must match (trimmed except for text): `'\\d{10}'` means ten digits. |

### `integer`, `money`

`integer`: a whole number. `money`: an integer string of minor units (bigint).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number \| string` | — | Smallest allowed value. |
| `max` | `number \| string` | — | Largest allowed value. |

### `decimal`, `percent`

A fixed-point number; for `percent`, '12.50' means 12.5 %. numeric(precision, scale); the wire value is a decimal string with `scale` digits.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `precision` | `number` | 18 (decimal), 7 (percent) | Total significant digits, 1 to 1000. |
| `scale` | `number` | `2` | Fractional digits, 0 to `precision`. |
| `min` | `number \| string` | — | Smallest allowed value. |
| `max` | `number \| string` | — | Largest allowed value. |

### `boolean`, `date`, `datetime`, `json`

`boolean`: true or false. `date`: a calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`. `datetime`: a UTC ISO timestamp with milliseconds. `json`: any JSON value (jsonb).

No type-specific props.

### `enum`

One value from `options`, stored as its `value`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `FieldOption[]` | required | The choices; values are unique and at most 255 characters. |

### `multiSelect`

Distinct values from `options` stored as a JSON array in `options` order; min/max count.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `FieldOption[]` | required | The choices; values are unique and at most 255 characters. |
| `min` | `number` | — | Minimum number of selected values. |
| `max` | `number` | — | Maximum number of selected values. |

### `manyToMany`

Records of another resource linked through a join table (not a column). The value is the array of linked ids; the actor must be able to view every record they add.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | `string` | required | Name of the linked resource. |
| `table` | `string` | `<owner table>_<field key in snake_case>` | Join table name. |

### `attachment`

One uploaded file, stored as the id of its attachments row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accept` | `string[] \| 'any'` | `DEFAULT_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS` | Lower-case file extensions accepted for upload, or 'any'. DEFAULT_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS lists documents, images and archives. |
| `maxSize` | `string` | `'20mb'` | Upload size limit such as '5mb'. |

### `belongsTo`

A record of another resource (integer foreign key, `RESTRICT`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | `string` | required | Name of the target resource. |

### `user`

A user of this deployment (foreign key to users). Choices are active members of the record's organization unit or its ancestors; readers see only the display name.

No type-specific props.

### `hasMany`

Child records of another resource that point back to this one (no column).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | `string` | required | Name of the child resource. |
| `foreignKey` | `string` | required | The child's belongsTo field key that references this record. |
| `inline` | `boolean` | `false` | Edit the child rows inside the parent form; they are saved in the parent's transaction. |

### `lookup`

A key of a lookup group managed on /admin/lookups.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | `string` | required | Lookup group key, for example one declared in the module's `lookups`. |

## Supporting types

### `Label`

A display label. Arabic is required: it is the base language of every system. Other languages are optional; a missing `label.<lang>` falls back to `label.ar`.

`{ ar: string; en?: string; [language: string]: string | undefined }`

### `FieldOption`

One choice of an enum or multiSelect field: the stored value and its display label.

`{ value: string; label: Label }`

### `TextConstraints`

Length limits and an anchored pattern of a text-like field. `pattern` is a RegExp source matched against the whole value, trimmed except for text (wrapped in `^(?:…)$`).

`{ min?: number; max?: number; pattern?: string }`

### `NumberConstraints`

Numeric limits. Money limits are canonical minor units (integer strings or safe integers); decimal and percent limits are decimal strings or numbers.

`{ min?: number | string; max?: number | string }`

### `HookContext`

What a hook receives: the write transaction, the acting user's id and the action.

`{ trx: Knex.Transaction; userId: number; action: Action }`

## Module options

A module (`app/modules/<name>/module.ts`) groups the resources of one application.

### `Module`

One application of a system, exported by `app/modules/<name>/module.ts`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Module (application) name: its folder under app/modules. |
| `reference` | `boolean` | `false` | An example module that `adula:module:remove` may unregister and archive (its tables are kept). |
| `label` | `Label` | required | The application's menu group label. |
| `dependsOn` | `readonly string[]` | required | Names of the modules whose resources this module's relations may reference. |
| `resources` | `readonly Resource[]` | required | The module's resource definitions. |
| `workflows` | `readonly WorkflowDefinition[]` | — | Versioned workflows of this module's submittable resources (phase 4). |
| `lookups` | `Readonly<Record<string, readonly ModuleLookup[]>>` | — | Lookup rows by group. adula:install inserts missing rows and never changes or removes existing ones, so administrator edits survive upgrades. |
| `defaultRoles` | `readonly ModuleRole[]` | — | Roles created by adula:install when no role has their key yet. An existing role is never modified, so administrators own every role after installation. |

### `ModuleRole`

A role a module ships; its rules go through the same validation as the roles screen.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | required | Stable key that workflows address ({ role: key }); see roles.key. |
| `name` | `string` | required | Arabic display name; administrators may rename it later. |
| `permissionLevel` | `number` | `0` | Permission level of the role's holders (compared with Field.permissionLevel). |
| `rules` | `readonly { subject: string; action: string; inverted?: boolean; conditions?: Conditions \| null; fields?: string[] \| null }[]` | required | Role rules: `subject` is a resource name or 'all', `fields` limits a rule to those fields, `conditions` to matching records and `inverted` makes it a denial. |

### `ModuleLookup`

A changeable list value a module needs before its records can be saved.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | required | The stored value. |
| `label` | `Label` | required | Display label. |
| `sort` | `number` | — | Position in the lookup's list. |
